posts.author: Raghav_Pateriya
posts.text: I don’t think stock price makes sense. I have invested in it. I think market is thinking Cell manufacturing is not as challenging as before. Chinese assembly line kits have made it “commoditised”. Current ALMM-2 compliant capacity is 27 GW but with Waree, Adani, Premier, Reliance, Vikram etc announcing massive capex, 80 GW more is in pipeline for next 2 years. Annual demand in India is 40-50 GW per year. So massive capex + low implied utilisation = potential balance sheet disaster. For Websol, management’s long term target 4GW. Currently it will scale upto 1.2GW, incurring 270 crore expenditur…
